description: This is an HTML source file that implements a web-based graphical user interface for visualizing and interacting with database structures and data. It contains markup, styling, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic behaviors such as loading database names, tables, and data, as well as user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles display of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Dynamically creates HTML to display table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content with expand/collapse for large objects or long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability.

search-terms: HTML, CSS, JavaScript for database visualization
